units.source_text: 登上去，只见右边一片宽阔的牡丹园和芍药园。

en.t: When they went up, they saw a broad peony garden and herbaceous peony garden on the right.

units.source_text: 这些园圃也还没有开花。

en.t: These gardens had not yet come into bloom either.

units.source_text: 而且，大概是新辟的，他们对这些园圃都不太熟悉。

en.t: Moreover, perhaps because they had only recently been laid out, they were not very familiar with these gardens.
